summary.text: Sebastian Stoss is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 36A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jim DeMay in a race with no incumbent.
A Circle Pines resident who says he has served as a legislative aide, he lists eliminating fraud, lowering taxes, improving education and public safety as his priorities.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Sebastian Stoss described himself as a lifelong Minnesotan living in Circle Pines with a record of conservative advocacy, and said he has served as a legislative aide.
He wrote that he brought to light at a Ramsey County public comment meeting that the county spends $38.4 million in property tax annually on 213 nonprofits and NGOs without audits.
Stoss listed endorsements from the Minnesota Police and Peace Officers Association and the Minnesota Farm Bureau.
